messages:
alex: ok team, kicking off the nightlift for the engine quant bundle. window 00:30-02:30 UTC, staggered roll with 10% increments. I'll watch the first 30m. :eyes:
maria: confirm image tag and pin? i pushed engine:v2.3-quant-20240318-build7 to registry earlier. planning to pin that for the roll.
jon: want rollback criteria up front — suggest p95 latency +3x over baseline OR error rate >2% OR any OOMs > 1 per shard in canary. also watch kv-cache eviction spikes. :rotating_light:
lee: release notes snippet ready, small change re: matmul kernel selection and quant weight order. need to update console model catalog notes after cutover.
maria: pin command: `/deploy pin service=engine image=engine:v2.3-quant-20240318-build7 ttl=6h reason="nightlift quant kernel"`
deploy-bot: Pin created: id=pin_20240318_7, target=engine, image=engine:v2.3-quant-20240318-build7, expires_in=6h — pinned by maria
jon: thanks. canary plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 8m watch per step. auto-fallback enabled. if any step hits rollback criteria, deploy-bot will pin previous image and halt.
lee: adding quick changelog: "improved matmul kernel ordering for quantized paths; fixes transient cache miss under long-prefixs; ABI unchanged". short enough for release note.
sre-ops: FYI, we've prewarmed GPUs in eu-west and us-west. please avoid full region swap during 01:00-01:30 UTC, that's maintenance slot for storage team. also set burst reserve to +15% during rollout.
alex: can we enable trace sampling for engine routes for the first 45m? need to triage any perf regressions quickly.
maria: enabling traces: `redwoodctl obs set-sampling --service engine --rate 0.2` 
jon: can we also turn on kv prefix metrics for canary group? watch eviction_rate and kv_miss_latency. if eviction_rate spikes > 50/s, abort.
sre-ops: autoscale tweak applied: min_replicas bumped +2 in canary pool, burst reserve +15% active. I'll monitor GPU temp and OOM logs.
deploy-bot: Canary started: rollout_id=roll_1719987654_c1, step=10%, watch=8m, auto-fallback=true. canary_nodes=[eu-west-1a x10, us-west-2b x8]
alex: first canary out now. watching p50/p95 and error rate. will post snapshots at +8m. :coffee:
(8m passes)
alex: first-check: p95 +12% (good), errors 0.3% (ok), no OOMs, eviction_rate steady. proceeding to 25%. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Rollout progressed to 25% (step_2). watch window started.
maria: quick note: kv cache warmup observed in eu-west — latency dropping as caches populate. expected.
jon: keeping thresholds tight. If p95 crosses 120ms or errors >2% I'll ask for immediate rollback.
lee: updated console draft with changelog and support notes, posting link: https://internal.redwood/notes/nightlift-1719987654
sre-ops: saw one worker report a transient CUDA driver warning at 25% -> restarted that instance, no client errors surfaced. continuing monitoring.
(30m passes)
alex: halfway through, things look stable. final 50% -> 100% planned after next check. reminder: pin TTL set to 6h; if we need quick rollback outside deploy-bot flow we can exec `/deploy rollback image=engine:previous --immediate`
maria: pushed release note to docs repo. also setting canary tag on model-catalog after full cutover.
jon: last sanity: enable detailed logs for first 2h post-cutover. small CPU overhead but worth it.
sre-ops: NOTE: if OOMs > 2 in any AZ or p99 latency > 200ms for >5min across canary, trigger evacuation and rollback.
alex: agreed. if criteria met: rollback now. otherwise we'll complete to 100% in ~40m. thanks all.
(deploy-bot final)
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% -> engine:v2.3-quant-20240318-build7. Summary: no rollbacks triggered. metrics: peak_p95_diff=+18%, errors_peak=0.9%, OOMs=0. All pins auto-cleared at ttl expiry unless extended.
alex: excellent. leaving pin to auto-expire. will add followup in eng-release channel with perf graphs and action items. good job team. :tada:
